readiness_checks.evidence: Registered manual paths and SHA-256 values in canonical document register.
readiness_checks.rationale: Only hash-matching local canonical documents may support adjudication.

readiness_checks.evidence: Phase 4E: 178 structurally readable FITS products, 0 inspection failures; extraction/filtering disabled.
readiness_checks.rationale: Structural readability is not scientific eligibility.

readiness_checks.item: Valid observation timestamps and time reference
readiness_checks.evidence: SoLEXS Unix-time claim is scoped; HEL1OS MJD/ISOT authority and disagreement handling remain partial.
readiness_checks.rationale: No combined observation-time policy is established.

readiness_checks.item: Applicable GTI intervals and endpoint semantics
readiness_checks.evidence: SoLEXS endpoint contract is missing; HEL1OS L1 GTI can be ignored only in the documented L1 scope.
readiness_checks.rationale: No GTI mask or endpoint convention may be applied.

readiness_checks.evidence: Candidate HEL1OS HK/status fields were structurally inventoried, but no L1 bit meaning, threshold, or rejection rule is documented.
readiness_checks.rationale: Missing metadata is not evidence of clean data.

readiness_checks.evidence: Fourteen HEL1OS V111/V211 counterpart groups have no authoritative supersession rule.
readiness_checks.rationale: Products remain separate; row counts and apparent recency are not precedence evidence.

readiness_checks.evidence: SoLEXS manual identifies ARF/RMF for spectral analysis but no applicable RATE-to-irradiance conversion; HEL1OS response policy remains incomplete.
readiness_checks.rationale: Count rate is not promoted to physical flux.

readiness_checks.evidence: Inventory includes 6 SoLEXS and 44 HEL1OS light curves, but valid exposure rules are incomplete.
readiness_checks.rationale: File presence and raw rows do not establish usable coverage.

readiness_checks.evidence: Phase 3B records 123 reference events, but instrument interval overlap is not verified.
readiness_checks.rationale: Reference catalog provenance does not establish instrument-positive windows.

readiness_checks.evidence: Canonical summary explicitly records negative-label completeness as false.
readiness_checks.rationale: Unobserved or uncatalogued intervals are not negative examples.

readiness_checks.evidence: Canonical summary: no final split boundaries; verified joint windows = 0.
readiness_checks.rationale: No eligible observation/label population exists for a leakage assessment.
